findings.title: Quadratic maximality scan can stall large tool-data ingests
findings.what: buildProcedures can produce O(C) qualifying windows for a long recurring command run, after which qualifying.filter(...qualifying.some(...)) compares every candidate with every other candidate. MAX_SEQUENCE_LEN bounds each window, but it does not bound the number of candidates, so three matching long sessions can drive O(C²) comparisons and substantial retained Map/Set memory on the ingest path.
findings.fix: Index qualifying candidates by project, sequence length, and contiguous subsequence identity, then test only possible longer supersequences; alternatively record occurrence/subsumption relationships while enumerating bounded windows so maximal candidates are selected without an all-pairs pass.
findings.acceptance: Add a deterministic performance regression using three identical long sessions and assert candidate selection scales approximately linearly with command count (or stays within an explicit time/operation budget), while preserving the existing higher-support-subprocedure and maximal-sequence results.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed lines 608-658 generate every length-3..8 window and lines 695-714 retain qualifying windows before an unbounded nested filter/some scan. The constant maximum window length does not remove the quadratic dependence on the number of qualifying windows.

findings.title: Prompt-clarity recommendation omits structured provenance
findings.what: The recommendation reports sample count, bucket means, Pearson correlation, affected count, and example sessions, but the returned object has no provenance block. Consumers therefore cannot reproduce the claims from cited promptAnalysis, timelines, and apiErrors fields or determine the observation date/staleness from the recommendation itself.
findings.fix: Add structured provenance observations for the included session IDs and counts, promptAnalysis lowSpecificityTurnCount/promptTurnCount, timeline user-turn counts, and apiErrors session counts; include an asOf date derived from the newest contributing artifact and mark stale historical results.
findings.acceptance: A fixture that fires this detector passes the repository provenance validator, cites every field used in the means/correlation, exposes the contributing session set, and renders stale input as 'As of <date>' with provenance.stale=true.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read of lines 85-166 confirmed all statistics are derived there and the returned recommendation ends after evidence without provenance or asOf/stale metadata; this is a current reproducibility defect, not a narrative-only omission.
